notes.title: We are the Plague - Patch #1 is now live!
notes.notes:

A new patch for We are the Plague on Steam is now live! We've listened to your feedback and the first batch of fixes and improvements is waiting for you - make sure your game is up to date!

PATCH NOTE:
- No more camping guys! Now the chance for a counter-attack when defending is lowered to 30% (previously 100%)
- Any collectors here? We added achievements for you!
- Check out the new snazzy summary screen with convenient improvements.
- Added some minor bug fixes

notes.title: Free huge update + price drop!!!
notes.notes: The new ultimate version of Violett brings even more of the best point and click adventure fun, right onto your screen. In this expanded version you'll see a pair of completely new levels, full of entirely new puzzles and specially composed music. Upgraded graphical effects in the game making the hand-painted, Escheresque surroundings look even more stunning. Redesigned and improved game mechanics as well as controls will let you solve the riddles presented to you with much more ease. If you ever get stuck by a particularly tricky puzzle, a redesigned system of tips will help you move forward. And newly added gamepad support will make your game much more pleasurable to play on your big screen TV or your PC's monitor.

notes.title: Update 01-08-2014
notes.notes:
Hi,

In this update we addressed an issue that was often mentioned. Controls. Now you do not have to make a swiping motion to activate an item or action. You just have to click on it and it happens automatically. We still recomment the original type of controls, but if you have trouble or just find them annoying you can toggle them in the options.

notes.title: Update 21-01-2014
notes.notes:
This time it's not a patch, but rather a content adding update.

We read lots of reviews and your suggestions and a common topic was that the ending could use something more. So we got back to our drawing desks and rewived and idea that we had before.

Changes in this update:

- A new more action based level added at the end of the game
